desc: Separate foods into 3 lists by vitamin type.
Implement function `compute_min_costs(foods, limit)` which returns an array `dp` of size `limit + 1` where `dp[v]` is min calories to get $\ge v$ vitamins.
Iterate $k$ from $X$ down to 0 and check if `cost1[k] + cost2[k] + cost3[k] <= X`.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., $X$ is small, no foods available for a vitamin type) are handled correctly (the code initializes with infinity and handles `inf` checks).
Confirm the output format matches the requirements.
